scenes.basis: 27:1 "When it was determined that we should sail for Italy, they delivered Paul and certain other prisoners to a centurion named Julius"; 27:2 "Embarking in a ship of Adramyttium, which was about to sail to places on the coast of Asia, we put to sea" - the embarkation port is not named; Paul sails from the custody of Caesarea (23:33-35; 25:13)
27:3 "The next day, we touched at Sidon. Julius treated Paul kindly, and gave him permission to go to his friends and refresh himself"

27:5 "we came to Myra, a city of Lycia"; 27:6 "There the centurion found a ship of Alexandria sailing for Italy" - the lee of Cyprus and the sea off Cilicia and Pamphylia (27:4-5) are the route, not stops

27:8 "With difficulty sailing along it we came to a certain place called Fair Havens, near the city of Lasea"; 27:12 "Because the haven was not suitable to winter in" - the deliberation happens at the haven; 27:13 weighing anchor is the departure leg
27:16 "Running under the lee of a small island called Clauda, we were able, with difficulty, to secure the boat" - the storm drives the ship from Crete to Cauda

27:27 "as we were driven back and forth in the Adriatic Sea" - the storm drifting between Cauda and the fourteenth night, the soundings and the anchors are on the open sea; the Syrtis fear (27:17) is a fear, not a position

27:39 "they didn’t recognize the land, but they noticed a certain bay with a beach, and they decided to try to drive the ship onto it" - the wreck site is an unnamed bay; the island is named Malta only after the landing (28:1)
